source: dispatch-shadow-wave4/BLOCKERS.md section 'Model call not via cio-governed-bridge' (37 lanes)
billing_note: 2026-11-07 (LQ-20261107-247): a lane's optional 'billing' block states which provider it actually pays and quotes the source lines that prove it. scripts/lib/llm_offpeak_guard.deepseek_payers() reads it: only a lane with 'deepseek_metered': false AND non-empty evidence is treated as not paying DeepSeek. Absent block, malformed block, or missing evidence = a DeepSeek payer (fail-closed), so a new lane is assumed to pay until someone shows otherwise. Lanes with no block below have not been examined and stay payers.
note: TRADEAI_LLM_VIA_BRIDGE defaults off. scripts/llm_lane.py generate() calls text_via_bridge only when the flag is on and process_id is set, and it raises BRIDGE_ROUTE_REFUSED instead of calling a provider. config/llm_process_registry.json and config/n8n_run_allowlist.json were not edited. A lane qualifies for the n8n llm class only after its process_id is registered, its allowlist entry declares llm_route via cio-governed-bridge, and the flag is how that lane runs. None of these 37 qualify on this branch.
